content: Obesity is a significant risk factor for the development of various cancers, including breast, colon, and gynecologic malignancies. Recent studies have revealed that obesity is not only associated with the onset of cancer but also affects the prognosis for many cancer patients. For instance, obesity has been linked with poorer outcomes in breast and colon cancers, whereas obese patients with gastric or renal cancers have shown more favorable prognoses.
